dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Uso was surrendered to the care center as a stray with no known history. During the day he spent with his finder, they reported that he had been friendly with their family. Uso has not acclimated well to the care center environment and has allowed minimal handling since intake. He was tail tucked and shaking during his medical examination, and avoidant of handlers during his handling assessment, where he was tense, seeking exit at the door, and would not approach. Due to Uso's fearfulness, we recommend he be placed with a New Hope partner who is able to provide an experienced foster home and re-evaluate behavior in a stable environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: Uso
